Training Officer Job at Stellar International Company Limited




        
    

        
        Stellar International Company Limited is a subsidiary of RSIN Group which entered Africa in 2008. Stellar International Co. Ltd has three businesses, namely Recycling Ant, Ant Express and Antshop Online.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Training Officer

Job Location: Sagamu, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibitlies
     

            
    




	Needs Assessment: Identify training gaps through job analysis, performance reviews, and consultation with functional managers.
	Program Development: Design, develop, and update training materials, curricula, and policies, often using Learning Management Systems (LMS).
	Implementation & Delivery: Oversee the scheduling, coordination, and delivery of training sessions, sometimes leading sessions directly.
	Staff Supervision: Manage, train, and provide feedback to trainers and other staff involved in learning and development.
	Evaluation: Measure training effectiveness, track progress, and report outcomes to senior management.
	Budget & Resources: Manage training budgets and resources, potentially liaising with external vendors.
	Onboarding: Coordinate and manage the training for new hires.
	Compliance & Safety: Ensure training aligns with company policies, procedures, and safety standards.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an HND / Bachelor`s Degree with 3 - 5 years of experience.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] cc: [email protected] using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Ascentech Services Limited - Our client, an Automotive / Lubricant company, is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: In-House Recruiter 

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Our client is seeking an experienced and results-driven In-House Recruiter to join our Human Resources team
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, developing effective sourcing strategies, and ensuring the organization attracts and hires qualified talent across various functions.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related field.
